info.name: EnergyMeneger — 3 workshops, 300/100 kW
info.description: Current repository: fixed 3 workshops at 100 kW each, substation 300 kW. All 7 controllers / 22 method-route combinations. No new objects or blocked/dismissed users. Fill all three passwords. Run folders in order. runWriteTests enables rejected writes and same-value updates (logs/history grow). runEquipmentTests additionally enables/disables the existing lathe, only when all equipment is initially off. Neither flag creates objects. Tests never change employee roles/status. One run uses 4 login attempts; allow 1 minute between repeated runs (limit 10/minute/IP).
